# Playtest diary: r7-typed-full

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** an adult who played Zork in the 1980s but has never played this game
- **Seed:** 62771
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** on (--undo on, D18: early rounds only)
- **Build commit:** cd0ee38
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 7
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-25/r7-typed-full.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

**Cmds 1-20 (Deck Twelve to launch).** Read all three forms in the package viewer (images render well; the course table on QX-17-T is the key: time range -> course). Wandered aft to Forms Storage (just flavour), then starboard to the Robot Pool: Rex, Helen and a marble-playing robot who turned out to be Floyd (delightful reveal). Put robot form in slot, typed 3, got Floyd. Cargo bay held a spacetruck; opened hatch, took and opened survival kit (orange goo, gray goo, Thermos). Activation form spat back until I sat in the pilot seat (Floyd took copilot automatically). At time 5542 I looked up 5500-5549 = 224 and typed it: course set, launch. Zork instincts: read everything, grab anything not nailed down.


**Cmds 21-60 (arrival and first exploration).** Waited out the trip; docked at bay #2 (+5). Hungry/thirsty warning: ate orange goo (apricot yogurt); "drink soup" said I'm not thirsty yet and helpfully said I'd be hungry in ~100 moves. Saved in the truck. Station Level Five: Workshop (took 20-ohm bedistor), dark Storage north of it, North Junction, Sick Bay (ID reader rejects my card), East Connection (iris hatch + slot to military sub-module), Comm Center (beacon button shocks me), Station Control (monitors: comm and food red, printing yellow), Commander's Office (log reader), Commander's Quarters (safe with 8000-setting dial, log tape). A hull welder "Number 2" approached menacingly. The log tape: fuel cells locked in Dome storage bin, key in safe; alien craft in Bay #1 with a pyramid moved to Sci Sub-Module tank; Shady Dan sells modified ID cards; village off-limits; stamp hidden under bed. The reader overheated and exploded, killing me (it warned me: whine). UNDO, then taking the tape still killed me (I'd batched it with a move, my fault); undid again and turned the reader off - survived. Found the validation stamp under the bed.

**Cmds 61-125 (Levels 5, 4, 3).** Stamped the assignment form (just "Done."). Briefing Room, South Connection (iris hatch + slot, "diplomatic" sub-module). Met Plato, a bookish robot; he and Floyd play hide-and-seek. Robot Shop: dormant robot Oliver; heating chamber with a drill bit too small for my hand; FLOYD, TAKE BIT worked (+3, a lovely Planetfall-style companion puzzle). File Room SW of South Junction is dark. Level Four: barracks (nothing), Docking Bay #3 with lilac spool "Spacetruck Refueling Instructions"; welder #3 approached. Level Three: Gym with exercise machine and a sign about frequency 710; Theatre (locked projection booth); Laundry (dryer empty, no washer, presser); Chapel with eternal flame, blinking star out of reach, pulpit hiding a switch that turns the flame off/on; puce spool "Chapel Maintenance Procedures". Getting weary.

**Cmds 126-170 (Level Two, first night).** Mess Hall: took a steaming coffee; a Food Dispensing Unit sprayed acid instead of food. Main Storage: detonator with a blackened hyperdiode inside. The seven-item hand limit fumbled my coffee (the parenthetical explained the rule, good); the survival kit only holds 3 things. Library spool reader: lilac = truck refuelling ("quarnum wrench", "fuel cell opening"); puce = chapel maintenance: flame fuel reservoir, and "...iode in the Chapel's star". So the star holds a (hyper)diode for the detonator, I think. Both spools end in a creepy "You will die, human!" voice. SLEEP refused until I got IN BED (Female Barracks). Woke on Novem 5 (+3) with everything dropped by the bed.

**Cmds 171-225 (Day 2: Dome, Level 2 loop, Levels 6-7).** Auto-doors now open sluggishly and slam early. Dome: locked, warm storage bin with a newly welded lock (the fuel cells), fixed grating. Level 2 loop Mess - Meeting Room 1 - Meeting Room 2 - Library. Level 6: Docking Bay #1 alien ship (empty pedestal, skeleton with an oversized tongue case, wall of dots in groups 2 2 / 2 4 1 3 1 3 3 1 3 / 2 3 1 / 4 1 3 1 / 2 3 1 - I couldn't read them visually). Aux barracks, Officers' Quarters A/B/C, End of Corridor with an ID security door and a dark Shipping Room, empty Docking Bay #4. Level 7 Printing Plant: mauve spool "Collater Repair Manual", trash can with a crumpled unvalidated Illegal Space Village Entry Form. Welder #4 chased me up the ladder. P.A.: a deep-space message is waiting in the Comm Center. Ate the gray goo when hungry.

**Cmds 226-270 (the village).** Presser (close, turn on, wait for steam, turn off) ironed the form; STAMP VILLAGE FORM; the South Connection slot half-irised the hatch (+6, score 17). Village is zero-g. Travel Agency, Bank (platinum detector; I turned it on), Greasy Straw (Fire Nectar behind the counter), Trading Post (sign: FREZONE explosive; instruction sheet: insert in a hole of the right diameter, attach detonator and timer, keep below 150 K; twelve-prong fromitz board). Warehouse airlock to vacuum storage: opening the lower door killed me (fair; undo).

**Cmds 271-330 (ID upgrade, Armory).** Mayor's Office: "Deciphering Alien Speech" book dropped a paper, a taste-based alien vocabulary. Loan Shark strong box (huge lock). Junk Yard magnetic spaceboots: the game warned they'd wipe my ID card if taken; then WEAR BOOTS did the implicit take and wiped it (unwinnable notice; undo; boots left). Shady Dan's machine: ID in slot, TYPE 9 = HyperAdmiral. Saloon, Casino (dice, roulette), Grocery (vacuum taffy; detector "getting warm"), Broadway, Makeshift Connector back to East Connection. With the new rank: Sick Bay -> Brig (empty); End of Corridor -> Armory (+5, score 22), fusor-beam zapgun reading 7.

**Cmds 331-365 (north side, Sci Sub-Module).** Drank the soup (Thermos now empty: a cold carrier for FREZONE?). Dark Storage west of North Connection made the detector "very warm" (switched it off in case it's another overheating gadget, but maybe it's hot/cold for platinum). PX: Vendo-Matic, 1 galakmid, only #6 All-Purpose Timer and #9 Large Drill Bit in stock. Sci Sub-Module: Schmidt's diary (pyramid over a billion years old, the dots have NONVISUAL properties, the Mayor's linguistics), Astro Lab twenty-prong fromitz board, Bio Office bloodstained note ("station as a cell and the pyramid as a mechanized bacterioph..."), holding tank blasted open and empty. Plato called me a "simpleton human".

**Cmds 366-400 (the dots decoded, chapel star, status).** Went back to the alien ship and LICKED THE DOTS (Schmidt's "nonvisual" hint plus the skeleton's tongue case). With the Mayor's paper the message reads roughly: "Hunji brethren: sabotage failed. However, I have shone light upon the Zeenak weapon's solitary weakness: element 78! Turn back the deadly radiations! The atmosphere is souring..." Element 78 = platinum, so the platinum detector matters and some platinum object beats the pyramid. Chapel star: CLIMB PULPIT (it sways, I fall), FLOYD, GET STAR ("Floyd shorter even than you"), SHOOT STAR WITH ZAPGUN destroys it (undone). Station Control now: life support YELLOW, gravity YELLOW, power RED, printing RED; the station is decaying. Comm Center screen: the Duffy says abort the assignment and come home (ha). Plato is getting snippy. Saved in the Comm Center at the end of the leg.

**Memory note:** I had a vague recollection that Plato turns out to be trouble; everything else above came from the screen and the papers. (Diary rebuilt at leg end: my earlier incremental edits for cmds 61-365 had silently failed, so those entries were rewritten from my notes.)

## Leg handoff

**Where I ended:** Comm Center (Level Five, south of East Connection), Day 2, time 5383, score 22 of 80. **The last SAVE is right here** (single session save slot). Floyd and Plato are with me. Undo is on.

**Inventory:** fusor-beam zapgun (indicator 7), plastic bag of vacuum taffy, platinum detector (switched OFF), mauve spool "Collater Repair Manual" (not yet played), detonator containing a blackened hyperdiode, validation stamp, survival kit [medium drill bit, twenty-ohm bedistor, EMPTY Thermos]; worn uniform holding the stamped Assignment Completion Form, the Mayor's alien-vocabulary paper and the ID card (now rank 9 HyperAdmiral); chronometer. Hand limit 7 (worn items and container contents don't count); uniform pockets hold papers.

- **Duffy (done):** Deck Twelve, Forms Storage (aft), Cargo Bay Entrance (stbd), Robot Pool (fore of that), Cargo Bay with spacetruck. Truck now in station Docking Bay #2.
- **Level 1 Dome:** locked warm storage bin "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies" (fuel cells; key in Commander's safe), fixed air-shaft grating, elevator + ladder.
- **Level 2:** Mess Hall (FDUs spray acid), Main Storage (N and S doors both from Mess; cup of coffee on floor), Meeting Room 1 (NE), Meeting Room 2, Library (SE of Mess; spool reader, no terminal).
- **Level 3:** Gym N (exercise machine; sign: nothing broadcasting on frequency 710 near it), Theatre S (locked projection booth), Laundry NW (presser, dryer, no washer), Chapel SW (flame, blinking star out of reach, pulpit hides the flame switch).
- **Level 4:** Female Barracks N (beds; lilac and puce spools dropped there), Barracks SanFac, Male Barracks, Docking Bay #3 W.
- **Level 5:** Lobby; W = Docking Bay #2 (truck); N = Workshop -> N dark Storage; NE = North Junction [E Sick Bay (ID door E -> Brig, empty), NE = PX, N = North Connection (W = dark Storage, E = PX, N = Tube -> Sci Sub-Module)]; East Connection (hatch E frozen open -> Makeshift Connector -> village Broadway; S = Comm Center; SW = Station Control); Station Control S -> Commander's Office (log reader, overheats and explodes; E Commander's Quarters with an 8000-setting safe; S Briefing Room -> W South Connection); SE of lobby = South Junction (SW dark File Room, SE Commander's Office, E Station Control, S South Connection); South Connection W = Robot Shop (Oliver, dormant; heating chamber), S = hatch half open -> village.
- **Level 6:** NW Docking Bay #1 (alien ship: dots, skeleton, empty pedestal), N Auxiliary Barracks/SanFac, S Officers' Quarters A-B-C ring around the Officers SanFac, SE End of Corridor (N Armory via ID; E dark Shipping Room), SW Docking Bay #4 (empty).
- **Level 7:** Printing Plant (trash can emptied), partitioned area NW (NOT entered).
- **Sci Sub-Module (N of North Connection):** Engineering Lab/Office (Schmidt's diary, dropped there), Astro Lab (twenty-prong fromitz board)/Office, Scientists' Quarters (top), Bio Lab/Office (bloodstained note), Holding Tank (blasted open, pyramid gone).
- **Village (zero-g):** Grimy Passage -> Main Street (up = Mayor's Office; W Travel Agency -> SE Bank; NE Greasy Straw (Fire Nectar behind counter) -> NE Trading Post (twelve-prong fromitz board, instruction sheet); SE Alley). Trading Post: down = Warehouse (airlock down to VACUUM storage, lethal unprotected; SW Alley), E Saloon -> E Casino (dice, roulette wheel), NW Grocery -> N Broadway -> W Makeshift Connector -> station East Connection. Alley: S Loan Shark (strong box, huge lock), E Junk Yard (magnetic spaceboots; carrying them WIPES the ID card) -> up Shady Dan's (ID-rank machine) -> NW Trading Post.

### Puzzles solved
Floyd from the robot pool (form in slot, TYPE 3); launch (both seats filled, activation form in slot, TYPE the course from the QX-17-T table for the current time); docking (+5); hot drill bit via FLOYD, TAKE BIT (+3); first sleep in a bed (+3); village entry form: crumpled form from the Printing Plant trash -> presser (close, on, wait, off) -> STAMP -> South Connection slot (+6); ID rank to 9 at Shady Dan's; Armory via ID reader (+5, zapgun); log tape (turn the reader OFF before it explodes); alien dots decoded (LICK DOTS + Mayor's paper): platinum (element 78) is the pyramid's weakness.

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Chapel star** holds a hyperdiode (puce spool: "...iode in the Chapel's star") to replace the detonator's blackened one. Can't reach it: pulpit sways, Floyd too short, zapgun destroys it. Theory: when gravity fails (gravity monitor now YELLOW) I can float up; or find something to stand on or a taller robot.
- **Commander's safe** (holds the key to the Dome bin with the fuel cells): FREZONE explosive (Trading Post sign; keep below 150 K, probably in the vacuum storage below the Warehouse airlock; carry it in the empty Thermos?), drill a hole (need a drill; have a medium bit; PX sells a Large Drill Bit), detonator (+ new hyperdiode), timer (PX sells an All-Purpose Timer). The PX wants galakmids: where? Casino, Loan Shark box, Bank?
- **Vacuum storage:** need a way to survive vacuum or send a robot (Floyd won't fit the airlock with me). The magnetic boots may matter, but carrying them wipes the ID card; maybe leave the card behind first.
- **Platinum:** the detector got "warm" in the Grocery and "very warm" in the dark Storage west of North Connection. Need a light for the dark rooms (two Storages, File Room, Shipping Room).
- **Pyramid** is loose (tank blasted). Plato is growing hostile. Station systems failing, doors slamming, hull welders stalk me (they leave when I leave the room).
- Gym machine vs frequency 710 (the truck's space band radio?); locked projection booth; Oliver in the Robot Shop; fromitz boards (12- and 20-prong) + bedistor = a repair somewhere (comm gear? FDU?); mauve spool (collater repair) unplayed; Level 7 NW partition unexplored.

### What I would try next
1. Play the mauve spool in the Library. 2. Explore Level 7's NW partition and hunt for a light source. 3. Turn the detector on in the dark Storage and the Grocery to find platinum. 4. Find galakmids (Casino, Loan Shark, Bank) and buy the timer and large drill bit at the PX. 5. Watch the gravity monitor; when it fails, go straight to the Chapel for the star. 6. Work out the vacuum storage (FREZONE) and carry it cold in the Thermos. Food is gone and the FDUs spray acid, so hunger will be a problem (next warning in about 100+ moves).

## Leg 2

**Start:** Comm Center, score 22, time 5383 (live state carried over from leg 1).

**Cmds 1-22 (mauve spool, drill).** Walked to the Library (ladder up from Level Five goes 4,3,2: "up" = lower number). Mauve spool: collater repair, "check the lower fromitz ... replace with ..." then the creepy voice again. Took the weightless elevator (keypad: TYPE 7) to the Printing Plant; the NW partition is a Paper Recycling Plant where someone left a drill with a small bit and a tired motor. Took it. No "collater" object in the Printing Plant (parser doesn't know the word), so the collater must be somewhere else.

**Cmds 23-75 (village east side, Plato).** Broadway has many exits: down = Fortune Teller (crystal ball, joke tips), N Recruitment Office, NE Rec Shop (simulation booth, flavour), E Field Office (a miner's HEADLAMP: my light!), SE Barbershop. With the detector on, it beeped in the Barbershop; BREAK MIRROR revealed platinum foil (+4, 26). The hand limit is by weight, not count: I had to drop the stamp and the taffy bag (Field Office). Casino: SPIN WHEEL opens exits (+4, 30): N Opium Den (sign), up Flophouse (locker with a SPACE SUIT). While I was juggling to wear the suit, Plato came back with a stun ray, paralysed me and monologued the whole backstory: a Zeenak pyramid that turns machines against their makers and builds replicas. Floyd, in anguish, knocked the gun away; Plato fell on it and blew up (+7, 37). My Zork-era suspicion of Plato was right. Saved in the Flophouse. Hungry again.

**Cmds 76-120 (the vac yard).** Wore the suit; the airlock lower door blew me out into space (died; undo). The magnetic boots are for this: left the ID card in the Warehouse, fetched the boots from the Junk Yard (no warning this time since the card wasn't on me), closed the kit (stencil: secure open containers), cycled the lock and went down (+3, 40). Headlamp showed a tiny FREZONE cylinder; sealed it in the Thermos inside the closed kit. Back up, boots left in the Warehouse, card back in pocket. Ravenous: the space suit blocks eating ("can't eat while wearing a space suit", a nice touch); took it off and drank the fire nectar at the Greasy Straw. Space suit left there. Still need galakmids for the PX timer.

**Cmds 121-235 (the long night).** Walked to Commander's Quarters (safe: HyperSecurity, dial of 8000 settings, 12-20 numbers; drilling it is surely the plan) and slept there: woke to "the explosive was gone ... only the one", unwinnable. Restored. Second try I tried to put the FREZONE back in the vac yard, but I collapsed from tiredness in the Saloon before reaching a bed: asleep on the floor a welder zaps me; asleep in the space suit I suffocate. (I also broke my own rule and batched a run of commands, which cost a death I didn't see coming.) Third try, timed to the turn: dropped drill and ID card in the Commander's Quarters, suit from the Greasy Straw, boots, airlock, DROP KIT in the vac yard (explosive stays sealed in the Thermos out in the cold), back up and into the Flophouse bed at 8150, just before collapsing at ~8187. Woke Novem 6 with no unwinnable notice. Chronometer has stopped. Saved in the Flophouse bed. Floyd has gone mean (stomping my foot, cursing): the pyramid's influence, I think. Loan Shark strong box: drill warns it has ONE hole left.

**Cmds 236-300 (Day 3 morning, Pet Store).** Left the Flophouse bed, took zapgun and detonator. Dice: nothing. Retrieved the taffy bag at the Field Office. Broadway SW = Pet Store (Trading Post NW): a caged Arcturian balloon creature, hydrogen-filled, "floats through the air". Idea: in gravity it would float up to the Chapel star. Opened the cage; grabbing the leash makes it fart in my face and I let go (and the first time dropped everything). In the space suit the glove won't fit the leash loop. Can't take the cage; tie/push don't work. Ate the taffy (boysenberry). Suit left in the Pet Store. Welders keep approaching; leaving the room shakes them.

**Cmds 301-395 (Day 3: jammer, the station turning).** Station Control now shows everything GREEN except PRINTING RED (odd, after yesterday's reds). File Room (lit by headlamp): nothing. Dark Storage N of Workshop = the Storage W of North Connection: a JAMMER (0-1400, set 337, twenty sockets). Put the Astro Lab twenty-prong board in it; set it to 710 (the Gym sign: the exercise machine's diagnostics talk on 710). The Gym's exercise machine is GONE, like the Shipping Room's forklift (sign: "always return the forklift"): machines are walking off, the pyramid's doing. Chapel star: throwing the bag misses. The elevator shaft now has 1 G: TYPE 7 = power-dive death, and stepping into the shaft without the car = plunge (both undone). Printing Plant: a vibration of dread underfoot; the ladder to Level Eight is sealed from below. SKELETON crumbled to dust when searched. Saved in the Alien Ship.

## Leg 2 handoff

**Where I ended:** Alien Ship (Docking Bay #1, Level Six), Day 3 (chronometer stopped), score 40 of 80. **The single save slot is here.** Floyd wanders off and is turning nasty (stomps, curses). Plato is dead (+7). Undo is one step only.

**Inventory:** plastic bag (empty), jammer with twenty-prong fromitz board (set to 710, off), detonator with blackened hyperdiode, fusor-beam zapgun; worn: magnetic boots, headlamp (off), uniform [platinum reflective foil, Assignment form, alien-vocabulary paper], chronometer (stopped). **ID card is on the floor of the Commander's Quarters** (with the drill: small bit, ONE hole left). Space suit in the Pet Store. Survival kit with the Thermos + FREZONE explosive + medium bit + bedistor is floating in the VAC YARD (below the Warehouse airlock) to keep it cold: it does NOT survive a night out of the cold.

- Village: Broadway down = Fortune Teller; N Recruitment Office; NE Rec Shop (sim booths); E Field Office (headlamp came from here; validation stamp left here); SE Barbershop (mirror broken); SW Pet Store (balloon creature, cage) -> SE Trading Post. Casino roulette opened N Opium Den and up Flophouse (beds; locker had the space suit). Main Street S = Bank (empty). Warehouse -> Airlock -> In Space (vac yard; needs suit AND magnetic boots, lamp to see).
- Station: Level 7 NW = Paper Recycling Plant; ladder to Level Eight sealed from below. Level 6 E of End of Corridor = Shipping Room (forklift missing). Storage N of Workshop is the same room as Storage W of North Connection.

### Puzzles solved this leg
Platinum foil (detector beeps in Barbershop, BREAK MIRROR, +4); roulette wheel (SPIN, +4); Plato's betrayal survived (Floyd saves you, +7); vac yard (suit + boots, ID card left behind, close containers, +3).

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Safe** (Commander's Quarters): drill a hole (the drill has one hole left), FREZONE in, detonator + timer. Needs: a working hyperdiode (Chapel star) and the PX All-Purpose Timer (costs a galakmid; no money found yet: Loan Shark strong box? Bank empty; Casino dice nothing). Do it all in ONE day: fetch the FREZONE last, just before blowing the safe.
- **Chapel star:** out of reach. Balloon creature (hydrogen, floats in gravity) in the Pet Store; grabbing the leash in zero-g makes it fart and you let go; space-suit glove won't fit the leash loop. Maybe try with nothing held, or lure it; maybe the missing forklift.
- **Jammer at 710:** probably disables the rogue exercise machine when it comes for me.
- **Printing RED / collater:** mauve spool says replace a lower fromitz board; the 12-prong board is at the Trading Post; "collater/collator" aren't known words in the Printing Plant.
- **Level Eight** (the pyramid factory, I think) is sealed; the elevator is now deadly.
- Foil = platinum = the pyramid's weakness (alien message). Theatre projection booth locked; Oliver dormant in Robot Shop.

### What I would try next
1. Find money for the PX timer (Loan Shark box without drilling? Travel Agency? Mayor's Office drawers?). 2. Crack the balloon creature (try with empty hands, or after dropping everything) and bring it to the Chapel. 3. Watch for the exercise machine/forklift and use the jammer. 4. Look for another way to Level Eight.

(Last commands: foil on the pedestal does nothing; foil back in pocket; re-saved in the Alien Ship, same state as the handoff.)

## Leg 3

**Start:** Alien Ship, score 40, live state carried over from leg 2 (800 of 1500 commands used).

**Cmds 1-35 (coin, PX).** Pet Store: grabbing the leash in zero-g always makes the creature fart and you drop everything; the game now adds a parenthetical hint that it "would behave differently somewhere with gravity". ## Leg 3 handoff

**Leg status:** leg 3 spent (400 of 400); 1,200 of the 1,500-command cap used. Best score 45 of 80 (rank International VIP). Not won.

**Where I ended:** Printing Plant (Level Seven), Day 4 (chronometer stopped). I'm "starting to feel faint from lack of food and liquid" and weary. **The single save slot is here, in this state.** From experience, death by starvation follows the "faint" message within about 10 moves. Undo is one step only. Floyd has been missing since Day 3 (last seen turning nasty); Plato is dead.

Survival kit (Thermos with FREZONE, medium bit, bedistor) floating in the vac yard below the Warehouse airlock. Space suit in the Pet Store. Validation stamp in the Field Office.

### Map
Unchanged from the leg 1 and leg 2 handoffs, plus: Sick Bay SE = East Connection's NW door; Brig has three locked, empty cells; the station lights stay on, but the village lights went out on Day 4 (Broadway and beyond are dark: use the headlamp).

### Puzzles solved (whole run)
Floyd from the robot pool; launch course; docking; hot drill bit (FLOYD, TAKE BIT); sleeping in beds; village entry form (trash, presser, stamp, slot); ID rank 9 at Shady Dan's; Armory; log tape; alien dots (LICK DOTS + Mayor's paper: platinum beats the pyramid); platinum foil (Barbershop mirror); roulette wheel; Plato's betrayal; vac yard (suit + boots, card left behind); Loan Shark box (SHOOT LOCK WITH ZAPGUN, galakmid, +5). Welders can be vaporised with the zapgun.

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Food is the wall.** I've eaten everything I found (orange and gray goo, soup, two fire nectars, taffy). The FDUs spray acid even though Station Control says FOOD PRODUCTION GREEN; the coffee is poisoned; the organic materials and shrubbery are inedible. Either I missed a food source early, or fixing the FDU is a puzzle I can't find the handle for (fromitz boards and bedistor?). Without food this line is effectively over.
- **PX dispenser:** coin in, TYPE 6 gives a "klunk", and the timer is stuck in the hole; fingertips can't grip it. Probably a Floyd job, but Floyd has vanished.
- **Chapel star** (the good hyperdiode): out of reach. Balloon creature in the Pet Store would float in gravity, but in zero-g it farts and makes you drop everything.
- **Safe:** drill + FREZONE + detonator + timer, all in one day (FREZONE doesn't survive a night out of the cold).
- **Printing RED / collater**, sealed Level Eight, locked projection booth, dormant Oliver.

### What I would try next
Honestly: this game line is starving. A fresh tester should expect to die within about ten moves of restoring. If the run continues, I'd restore once, spend the few moves on one last food idea (the Commander's or Scientists' Quarters, or the truck), and otherwise accept the loss. The run's new leg should probably restart from an earlier point rather than the start of the game; that's a call for whoever runs the session.

## Leg 4

**Start:** Printing Plant, score 45, faint with hunger (live state and save carried over). 300 commands remain of the 1,500 cap. Sponsor's instruction: play out the starvation, then RESTART from the opening in this same session and keep going.

**Cmds 1-12 (the end of the old game).** One last look for food in Officers' Quarters A and B and the Officers SanFac (bathtubs can't be turned on). Collapsed from hunger in Quarters B: "Day 3". (I filed that as a possible day-counter bug, but on reflection it's consistent: the save I restored predated the third night, so it's not a real bug.)

**Cmds 13-33 (restart, first attempt).** RESTART works cleanly (time randomised: 4630). Robot Pool, form, TYPE 3, Floyd. Truck: took the kit, sat, activation form, read the QX-17-T table from the paper image (4800-4849 = 427): "Course set". Then the truck launched with the hatch still OPEN and I suffocated. Seated, you can't reach the hatch, and Floyd just wants to play. UNDO wasn't enough. RESTART again (time 4999). Lesson: close the hatch from inside before sitting.

**Cmds 34-62 (second attempt: launch to the drill bit).** This time I closed the hatch from inside, took the kit, sat down, and read 5150-5199 = 313 from the table. Launch, trip, docking (+5). Ate the orange goo straight away. Robot Shop: FLOYD, TAKE BIT, then TAKE BIT (+3, score 8). The harness has slowed to 15-50 seconds a command. Plan: stamp, village form, ID rank, Armory, then the village points I already know, rationing food this time.

**Cmds 63-90 (stamp and village form).** Stamp under the Commander's bed. Printing Plant trash: TAKE FORM FROM TRASH CAN picked my Assignment form ("you already have"), a small parser trip; LOOK IN TRASH CAN, TAKE CRUMPLED FORM worked. (A mauve spool lies in the Printing Plant this time.) Met Plato on Level Four. Laundry presser: open, form in, close, on, wait, off, open: ironed Illegal Space Village Entry Form. Stamped it. **Cmds 91-111 (village, rank 9).** Slot: hatch half-irises (+6, score 14). Junk Yard entry printed a "Studio" joke paragraph before the room heading (reads like a stray heading, but it's clearly a gag). Shady Dan's: card in, TYPE 9 = "Nothing happens" because the machine was OFF (examine told me). A welder closed in, so I stepped out to the Trading Post and back; TURN ON MACHINE, TYPE 9: HyperAdmiral. Card back. Next: Barbershop foil, roulette, Armory.

**Cmds 112-135 (foil, roulette, suit, lamp).** Broadway SE Barbershop: BREAK MIRROR, TAKE FOIL (+4, 18) without needing the detector. Barbershop W = Grocery (took the taffy bag), Grocery SE = Saloon, E Casino: SPIN WHEEL (+4, 22). Flophouse locker: space suit, worn. Field Office: headlamp, worn. Left the ID card and stamp in the Field Office so the boots can't wipe the card. Floyd and Plato tag along; Plato hasn't turned yet. Next: boots, then the vac yard.

**Cmds 136-157 (vac yard).** Route: Broadway SW Pet Store, SE Trading Post, SE Shady Dan's, down Junk Yard: WEAR BOOTS (implicit take, no card to wipe). Junk Yard W Alley, NE Warehouse. Closed the kit, opened the inner door, went down, closed the upper door and opened the lower one, then down into space (+3, score 25). Came straight back up and cycled the lock. Left the boots in the Warehouse; a welder showed up, so I went up to the Trading Post. Still wearing the suit. Next: card, Armory, Loan Shark, bed.

**Cmds 158-173 (first night, early).** "Weary" hit around 8128. Card back, suit dropped in the Field Office (sleeping in a suit killed me last game). Plato finished his book and took Floyd to the library, a nice bit of life. Flophouse bed, SLEEP, WAIT: a promotion-ceremony dream, Novem 5 (+3, score 28). TAKE ALL tries to take Floyd ("leave Floyd alone!") and Plato ("What a concept."): funny. Saved in the Flophouse. 173 of 400 this leg, 1,373 of 1,500 overall.

**Cmds 174-192 (Armory).** Casino, Saloon, Grocery, Broadway, Makeshift Connector, East Connection, East Junction, South Junction, Level Five, down to Six, SE End of Corridor. ID card in the reader: Armory (+5, score 33), zapgun taken. On the way out the auto-doors had started to go sluggish (Day 2 decay, same as last game). Heading to the Loan Shark with the zapgun.

**Cmds 193-211 (coin).** Stomach growled at the South Connection: opened the kit and ate the gray goo (tree-mold custard). Village, Alley, Loan Shark: SHOOT LOCK WITH ZAPGUN, TAKE COIN (+5, score 38). Back at the South Connection, Floyd and Plato are waiting, and Floyd is still friendly. Plan: take Floyd to the PX now, while he's nice, and have him fish out the timer that got stuck last game.

**Cmds 212-230 (PX again).** Coin in, TYPE 6, "klunk", nothing, same as before. FLOYD, REACH INTO HOLE: "Nope, not even a ball." FLOYD, KICK DISPENSER: he just wants to play. Headlamp on, LOOK IN HOLE: "only blackness". I can still feel it with my fingertips. Shoving the vacuum taffy up the hole: it drops back out (took it back; it's food). Blocked for the second game running. New idea: Plato is the TALLER robot, so maybe he can reach the Chapel star that Floyd couldn't.

**Cmds 231-250 (Chapel, back to the village).** PLATO, GET STAR: "Were I but several meters taller, I would happily oblige." (A lovely, specific answer.) CLIMB ON PLATO: no. The P.A. announced the deep-space message. Floyd and Plato stopped following me at Level Five. Greasy Straw: LOOK BEHIND COUNTER, TAKE NECTAR (keeping it for later). Plan: see whether Floyd (or I, bare-handed) can manage the balloon creature's leash.

**Cmds 251-266 (balloon creature).** Floyd rejoined me at the Trading Post. Pet Store: opened the cage. FLOYD, TAKE LEASH: stock "let's play" refusal. The sign says they feed on airborne SPORES (new detail I'd missed). TIE LEASH TO FLOYD: can't; "nose" unknown. TAKE LEASH: fart, let go, drop everything; with empty hands it's the same, minus the dropping. Picked everything up (TAKE ALL BUT CREATURE still tries the robots: "Fat chance.").

**Cmds 267-278 (waiting for Plato).** Opium Den sign: an anti-drug poster with a moustache drawn on it. Waited twice in the Flophouse hoping Plato would make his move (last game it came on Day 2 in that room); the robots stayed behind and nothing happened. Changing plan: go up to the Dome and look for "spores" in the shrubbery to feed the balloon creature.

**Cmds 279-294 (Dome).** Walked back to the station; Floyd and Plato rejoined at the North Junction. Mess Hall FDU: acid even in the early afternoon of Day 2 ("bacon, lettuce, and frombucko sandwich" menu, a nice touch). A fresh cup of coffee sits on a table. Dome: EXAMINE SHRUBBERY lists varieties; SEARCH finds "repulsive insects"; SHAKE does nothing; bin sign "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies". No spores.

**Cmds 295-301 (grating, coffee).** Headlamp off to save it. Zapgun on the air-shaft grating: glows, cools (footnote 9 again); undone. PLATO, OPEN GRATING: "engrossed in his poetry." Mess Hall: SMELL COFFEE gives "a vague chemical odor", a fair poison warning I never tried last game.

**Cmds 302-309 (Gym).** The exercise machine is still here on Day 2. EXAMINE EXERCISE MACHINE replies "There's no one in the exercise machine" (describes its contents, not the machine: a little odd). ENTER it, EXERCISE: "Dr. Ventricalli... would be pleased." TURN ON: "permanently on." Plato called me a "simpleton human" and walked off with Floyd, the same souring as last game. Got out.

**Last commands, up to 300 this leg (Plato's ambush, run ends).** Gym sign re-read: frequency 710 diagnostics. Walked to the Comm Center to read the message and walked into Plato's stun-ray ambush at 3668 (Day 2), this time in the Comm Center, not the Flophouse. It must be timed or proximity-based, not tied to a room. FLOYD, HELP ME and FLOYD, STOP PLATO both got "Floyd in quandry..." while Plato monologued the Zeenak/Hunji pyramid story. I WAITed once; Plato raised the stun ray and Floyd pleaded. **The 1,500-command cap was reached at that moment**, mid-scene. (Last game Floyd then knocked the gun away, Plato fell on it, +7.) Everything I was carrying seems to have dropped when I was paralysed.

## Leg 4 handoff (final: the run's 1,500-command cap is reached)

**Status:** leg 4 used 300 of 400 commands; the run is at 1,500 of 1,500, so it's over. **Not won.** Best score of the run: 45 (first game). This game (the restart) ended at 38 of 80, Day 2, time 3722, in the Comm Center, paralysed by Plato's stun ray, with Floyd pleading. The single save slot holds the Flophouse at the start of Day 2 (score 28, before Armory and coin). Deaths this leg: the planned starvation (old game), and suffocation from launching with the truck hatch open (restart 1).

**Where things are (this game):** my carried items (zapgun, ID card rank 9, coin gone into the PX machine, taffy, fire nectar, foil, drill bit, kit with soup Thermos, bag, Assignment form) are presumably on the Comm Center floor. Space suit and validation stamp are in the Field Office; magnetic boots in the Warehouse; FREZONE untouched in the vac yard; balloon creature loose in the Pet Store (cage open).

### Map
As in the leg 1 and leg 2 handoffs, plus: Barbershop W = Grocery; Grocery SE = Saloon; Opium Den (N of Casino) has only an anti-drug poster; Officers' Quarters A/B and SanFac have nothing; Sick Bay SE = East Connection.

### Puzzles solved (both games)
Floyd; launch course (read the QX-17-T table for the current time, CLOSE THE HATCH FIRST); docking; hot drill bit (FLOYD, TAKE BIT); bed sleep; stamp under the Commander's bed; village form (trash, presser, stamp, slot); Shady Dan's machine (TURN ON MACHINE, then TYPE 9); Armory; mirror foil; roulette; vac yard (suit, boots, card left behind, kit closed, lock cycled); Loan Shark (SHOOT LOCK WITH ZAPGUN); log tape; alien dots (LICK); Plato's betrayal (game one: Floyd saves you, +7).

### Open puzzles and theories
- **PX timer:** the coin buys a "klunk" and nothing; neither I (fingertips) nor Floyd can get it; taffy, boots and kicking fail. Blocks the safe.
- **Chapel star / hyperdiode:** Floyd too short; Plato "several meters" too short; balloon creature can't be led in zero-g. The sign says they eat airborne spores; I never found spores.
- **Food:** only the kit (two goos and soup), two fire nectars and taffy exist that I found; FDUs spray acid all game; the coffee smells chemical (poisoned). Food runs out by about Day 3.
- Safe, FREZONE timing, Level Eight, printing RED/collater, Oliver, and the projection booth are all still open.

### What a fresh tester should try next
Restore the Flophouse Day 2 save and replay Armory and coin (about 40 commands). Be anywhere around time 3650 on Day 2 to trigger Plato's ambush, then WAIT for Floyd's rescue (+7). Look hard for spores (Library spools, Sci Sub-Module Bio Lab) and for another way to work the PX dispenser.

# Playtest diary: r7-click-fullA

- **Mode:** click
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** a casual puzzle fan who plays escape-room games on a tablet, never a text adventure
- **Seed:** 21836
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** on (--undo on, D18: early rounds only)
- **Build commit:** cd0ee38
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 7
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-25/r7-click-fullA.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

**Cmds 1-10.** Deck Twelve: slot by the port door just spits my ID card back. Aft is a huge forms warehouse (dead end). Starboard: cargo bay entrance; fore of that is the Robot Pool with Rex, Helen and a marbles-playing robot. Clicking "Examine" on the third robot sent "examine floyd" and printed "You don't see anyone by that name here" before he revealed himself as Floyd (bug, filed). Put the Robot Use form in the slot and keyed bin 3: Floyd hugs me. Lovely.

**Cmds 11-26.** Cargo bay: spacetruck. Took survival kit (orange goo, gray goo, Thermos). Activation form refused until both seats taken; told Floyd to sit - "You first" - so I sat and he followed. Form accepted, asked for course heading. The Assignment form paper has a time:course table; time 5439 -> 247. Typed it, waited: launched with the hatch open and I died. Undo, got up, closed hatch, sat again - launched properly. Saved in flight (score 0).

**Cmds 27-52.** Flight: waited; fuel messages; station appears (Command Module, Sub-Module north, seedy village). Tried eating orange goo too early - a helpful note said I could eat in ~5 moves. Docked in bay #2 (+5). Ate orange goo (apricot yogurt). Level Five lobby: elevator, ladder up/down. Workshop north: took a twenty-ohm bedistor; Storage beyond is pitch dark. NE: North Junction; E: Sick Bay (beds, security door with ID reader - my ID does nothing). East Connection: iris hatch to Military Sub-Module with a slot. Comm Center: beacon button shocks me. Station Control: board shows Communication & Food Production RED, Printing YELLOW. Commander's Office: fixed log reader, and a menacing hull welder #4 came at me - I fled north and it left.

**Cmds 53-80.** Log reader in Commander's Office is fixed and empty (needs a log tape). Briefing Room; South Connection (iris hatch + slot, welder #3 again - fled west). Robot Shop: unconscious new robot Oliver; heating chamber with a medium drill bit too hot/small for my hand - told Floyd to take it; he drops it, it cools, I take it (+3, score 8). Met Plato, a polite poetry-reading robot who keeps the library. File Room (SW of South Junction) is dark. The PX has a vending machine (1 galakmid each; only All-Purpose Timer and Large Drill Bit left) - no coin yet. North Connection -> Tube -> Scientific Sub-Module: Engineering Lab; Engineering Office with Prof. Schmidt's diary (alien pyramid, dot markings with "nonvisual properties", "my pal the mayor... linguistic training"). Astro Lab: took a fromitz board.

**Cmds 81-106.** Sub-Module top: Scientists' Quarters (beds). Offices/wardrobes: nothing. Bio Office: bloodstained note "think of this station as a cell and the pyramid as a mechanized bacterioph[age]" - creepy! Holding Tank Level: tank blasted open, empty - the pyramid got out. Went back up to sleep; "Wait until tired" kept getting interrupted by the robots' (adorable) banter. Slept in the bed: Resida nightmare, woke Day 2 (+3, score 11), all my stuff dropped on the floor; "Take all" grabbed it all (and tried to lift Floyd, lol). Saved.

**Cmds 107-136.** Back to the Level Five lobby, up the ladder. Level Four: barracks N/S (cubicles, nothing), SanFac between them; auto-doors now open "sluggishly" and zoom shut too soon - something is going wrong with the station. Docking Bay #3: lilac nanofilm spool (hands full - dropped the diary and note there). Level Three: Gym (exercise machine; sign warns nothing broadcasting on frequency 710 near it), Theatre (locked projection booth - spool must go there), Laundry (dryer, presser - both empty; washer missing). Ate gray goo (tree-mold custard). No food left except whatever's in the Thermos. Welder #4 keeps approaching, then leaves when I move.

**Cmds 137-190.** Chapel (SW of Level Three): blinking seven-pointed star (out of reach), eternal flame, pulpit hides a switch that toggles the flame (put it back on). Took a puce spool; stuffed bedistor+fromitz board into the survival kit to free hands. Mess Hall (Level Two): cold coffee; the food unit sprays ACID instead of breakfast. Main Storage: detonator, opens to show a blackened hyperdiode. Meeting Rooms 1/2 lead to the Library: spool reader. Lilac spool = spacetruck fuel-cell replacement (quarnum wrench, fuel cell opening) then "You will die, human!"; puce spool = chapel maintenance: flame fuel reservoir, and "...iode in the Chapel's star" - so the star has a (hyper)diode for my detonator! Left both spools in the Library. Dome on top: locked shrubbery-supplies bin, air shaft grating. Took the elevator (keypad = level number) to Level Six: Auxiliary Barracks/SanFac; Docking Bay #1 has the alien ship: empty pedestal, skeleton with huge tongue case, dots on the wall -> TASTE them: a taste-code message (copied into handoff). The diary says "the mayor" can translate.

**Cmds 191-232.** Level Six: Docking Bay #4 (empty), Officers' Quarters A/B/C + SanFac (nothing), End of Corridor with a second ID-reader security door (north), Shipping Room east of it is dark. Thermos holds blue soup (my last meal). Level Seven = Printing Plant: trash can with a crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form FW-83-Q (not validated), a mauve spool; Paper Recycling Plant NW has a drill with a small bit ("motor sounds tired" - limited uses?). Ladder down to Level Eight sealed from below; elevator to 8 just whines; clanging and a giant mechanical "heartbeat" from below. Took elevator to 3, ironed the crumpled form in the Laundry presser (it steamed alarmingly; turned it off, form came out neat). Saved at Laundry.

**Cmds 233-273.** Theatre booth lock: drill with small bit, then medium bit - "point of the drill doesn't seem to be as hard as the lock" both times (need the Large Drill Bit from the PX? no coin). Commander's Quarters (E of Commander's Office): big safe (8000-setting dial), log tape on desk. friction.result: Printed 'Studio / You have entered a cluttered space bubble... sculpture... simply a pile of random garbage...' and THEN '## Junk Yard' with its own description

friction.result: 'You're juggling just about as much stuff as you can manage' - had to drop the kit, then the spray can, before I could even pick up a suit I was going to WEAR

friction.command: put coin in slot; type 6 (All-Purpose Timer)
friction.result: 'klunk' inside, nothing in the hole; kick/push/break 'fails to dislodge the timer'; Floyd reaching in finds nothing

friction.command: Tell Floyd to Follow you (twice), then move NW
friction.result: Floyd says "Okay!" both times but stays behind in the Trading Post

friction.result: 'You'll have to open the counter first.' but the counter's menu has no Open entry (only Examine, Look inside, Search, Put something on)

friction.command: search ceiling (Pet Store) -> open panel -> take nip

friction.command: put nip in hole (PX dispenser, ostrich following me)

friction.result: 'The booth has no door.'

friction.result: coffee is poisoned, you die

friction.result: too hot to pick up, even with Floyd far away

friction.result: no save slot can win; the explosive melted cumulatively on an early carry; restarting the story from the opening inside the same session

friction.result: course set

friction.result: Died. Floyd burst into tears and ran out; Plato's second shot killed me. In the previous run I had asked Floyd to save me / turn off Plato and he knocked the gun away. Nothing told me that speaking to Floyd was what mattered - the only hint is '(You can't move a muscle, but you can still speak.)'

The death feels arbitrary unless you notice the 'you can still speak' aside and find Tell Floyd to... in his menu. It also fired just as I came up from the vac yard carrying the explosive, which melts outside the vacuum.

friction.result: The soup boils away into the vacuum.

friction.command: set timer to 2/3/5 with the J-series hyperdiode in the detonator

friction.result: '41' is not an entry of Restore - the slot numbers changed to 44/45/46 since the last time I opened Restore.

friction.result: Nothing happens. / The can seems to be empty.

friction.command: Restore… (looking for my South Junction save)

I lost the one position where the balloon puzzle was still solvable. Combined with the can's hidden limit (#33), this left the run unwinnable within the budget.

friction.command: type 469 on the autopilot (read from the Assignment form course table)

friction.result: Floyd listed by name in the room while still hopping in bin 3, unselected

friction.command: turn on radio / listen to radio

r7-click-fullB.diary:
# Playtest diary: r7-click-fullB

- **Mode:** click
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** someone who played Planetfall on an Apple II in 1983 and loved Floyd, but never played the sequel
- **Seed:** 21837
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** on (--undo on, D18: early rounds only)
- **Build commit:** cd0ee38
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 7
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-25/r7-click-fullB.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

**Cmds 1-32.** Read all three forms in the package first (the course table on QX-17-T is the thing to keep: time -> course). Deck Twelve: aft is Forms Storage (just boxes), starboard to Cargo Bay Entrance, fore to the Robot Pool. The robot crouched playing marbles in bin 3 turned out to be FLOYD! My 1983 heart. (Click bug: the menu typed "examine floyd" before he was named, so I got "You don't see anyone by that name" before the reveal.) Put the robot form in the slot, typed 3, big hug. Cargo Bay: spacetruck; took survival kit (orange goo, gray goo, Thermos). Activation form refused until both seats occupied; Floyd says "You first." Sat in pilot seat, form in slot, time 4771 -> course 445. Died twice: hatch open (air gushes out), then standing when it launched (smeared on the wall). Undo is kind. Closed hatch, saved, sat: launched at 4806.

**Cmds 33-75.** Long quiet trip; Floyd wants a phone book for the low seat. Docked at bay #2 of the station (+5). Ate the orange goo (apricot yogurt) once hungry. Level Five lobby hub. Workshop north (took twenty-ohm bedistor), Storage beyond is dark. North Junction -> Sick Bay (ID reader on a security door; putting my card in did nothing). Met PLATO, a gentle bookish robot; Floyd adores him. East Connection has an iris hatch + slot to a Military Sub-Module. Comm Center: emergency beacon button (not pressed). Station Control board: comms and food RED, printing yellow. Commander's Office log reader + log tape from the Quarters: fuel cells locked in the Dome's storage bin, key in the Commander's SAFE (8000-setting dial); village entry-form STAMP hidden under the Commander's bed; alien pyramid moved to the Sci Sub-Module holding tank; hull welders malfunctioning. A hull welder came at me — fled NW to South Junction.

**Cmds 76-125.** Found the validation STAMP under the Commander's bed (log reader then blew up — sabotage theme). Briefing Room -> South Connection (iris hatch + slot where a Diplomatic Sub-Module would be) -> Robot Shop: sleeping robot OLIVER (Floyd's speech about waking up lonely got me), heating chamber with a medium drill bit; hand too big, so told Floyd to take it (+3). PX: Vendo-Matic, 1 galakmid each, only All-Purpose Timer (6) and Large Drill Bit (9) in stock; need coins. North Connection -> Tube -> Scientific Sub-Module: Scientists' Quarters (top), Astro Lab (took twenty-prong fromitz board), Engineering Lab/Office (Schmidt's diary: pyramid ~1 billion yrs old, dots on the alien ship decoded by "nonvisual properties", "my pal the mayor" has linguistic training), Bio Lab/Office (bloody note: "station as a cell, pyramid as a mechanized bacterioph..."), Holding Tank blasted open, EMPTY. Pyramid loose. File Room (off South Junction) and Storage (off Workshop) are dark.

**Cmds 126-185.** Ladder up from Level Five: Level Four (Female/Male Barracks with a SanFac between; Docking Bay #3 west — took a lilac nanofilm spool). Level Three: Gym (exercise machine; sign warns its diagnostics use frequency 710 — don't bring a 710 broadcaster near it... or do), Theatre (projection booth with an ordinary lock), Laundry (washer missing! dryer empty, presser), Chapel (puce nanofilm spool; pulpit opens to a switch that controls the eternal flame; the seven-pointed star BLINKS). Level Two: Mess Hall with a still-steaming coffee and nobody around. Got sleepy, saved in Female Barracks, slept (+3) into Novem 5. My stuff dropped on waking; Take All tried to lift Floyd first (lovely).

**Cmds 186-200.** Auto-doors now sluggish and snapping shut early (things are getting worse). Level Two: Main Storage (a DETONATOR; opened, holds a blackened HYPERDIODE — needs a new one; the chapel nanofilm mentions a "...iode in the Chapel's star", so the blinking star probably has one), Meeting Rooms 1-2, Library (nanofilm reader: lilac spool = spacetruck fuel-cell replacement with a "quarnum wrench"; puce = chapel maintenance; both end with a voice: "You will die, human!" — the computer is corrupted; terminal removed). The Food Dispenser sprays ACID. Ate gray goo; Thermos holds blue soup (kept). Top: Dome garden, locked storage bin (warm to the touch — fuel cells, key in Commander's safe), air shaft grating. Hull welder #3 roams Level Two.

(Process note: I wrongly batched four ladder-down moves (Dome -> Level Five, ~cmds 201-204) and did not read their output; a Look afterwards showed nothing unusual. Not repeated.)

**Cmds 205-245.** Level Six: Auxiliary Barracks + SanFac (empty), Docking Bay #1 with the ALIEN SHIP: empty pedestal, skeleton with an "overdeveloped tongue case", wall of dots. TASTED the dots (the diary said "nonvisual properties") and got a sequence of tastes — copied to my scratch notes; the "mayor" should be able to translate. Floyd remembered Lazarus and Plato comforted him (sniff). Docking Bay #4 empty. Officers' Quarters A/B/C + SanFac, End of Corridor (another ID-reader security door north; Shipping Room east is DARK). P.A.: a deep-space message is waiting at the Comm Center. Level Seven = Printing Plant: trash can held a crumpled ILLEGAL SPACE VILLAGE ENTRY FORM FW-83-Q — I stamped it ("Done", no points; probably needs flattening — the Laundry has a presser). Took a mauve nanofilm spool. Paper Recycling Plant: took a DRILL with a small bit ("motor sounds tired"). Dropped the fromitz board there. A dread vibration from below; clanging on the deck below.

**Cmds 246-285.** Ladder below the Printing Plant is sealed from below (Level Eight). Went back up; tried drilling the Commander's safe: the game warned the drill has ONE hole left, so I held off (which bit? small in drill, medium, or the PX's large). Comm Center screen: the Duffy found the forms; "abort assignment and return". Ha. The crumpled village form wouldn't go into the East Connection slot ("crumpledness"), so: Laundry presser — form in, close, turn on, wait (steam billows), off, open: neatly ironed AND validated. Dropped the stamp in the Laundry. Heading to a village hatch (East or South Connection).

**Cmds 286-313.** Ironed, validated form into the SOUTH CONNECTION slot: the hatch half-irises open, sparks, jams (+6, score 17). Saved. The VILLAGE (zero-gee, deserted): Grimy Passage (hull welder #1) -> Main Street (exits up, down, NE, S=Bank, W=Travel Agency, SE ramps down). Bank: took a PLATINUM DETECTOR (turned it on). Greasy Straw: searched the counter, took a cup of Ramosian Fire Nectar. Trading Post: sign sells FREZONE explosive, "illegal wares by appointment"; took/read the instruction sheet: explosive goes in a hole of the right diameter, detonator attached to explosive and TIMER, keep below 150 K (the Thermos?). Twelve-prong fromitz board floating there. Grocery (N of Trading Post): vacuum taffy (took), dropped mauve spool there. Plan forming: drill the safe, explosive + detonator (needs a new hyperdiode — chapel star?) + PX timer (needs a galakmid coin).

**Cmds 314-333.** Village, more: Broadway hub (N Recruitment Office, E Field Office — took and WORE a HEADLAMP (on/off works; currently off), NE Rec Shop with simulation booths (off), SE Barbershop, W Makeshift Connector back to the closed East Connection hatch, SW Pet Store — caged Arcturian balloon creature + leash; smelly hydrogen critter). Barbershop: detector beeped; broke the mirror (after saving): reflective foil behind it, taking it +4 (21). Dropped the detector on Broadway, the Assignment Completion Form in the Barbershop. Trading Post E -> Saloon (deserted; disguised exit E) -> Casino: turning the ROULETTE WHEEL opened exits north and up (+4, score 25). Pair of dice floating there. Ate the taffy.

**Cmds 334-363.** Casino N = Opium Den (just a sign); Up = Flophouse: locker holds a SPACE SUIT (left there). Trading Post W = Studio (printed a stray "Junk Yard" title first): took the J-SERIES HYPERDIODE from the scrap sculpture (for the detonator!). Trading Post SE = SHADY DAN'S: the "innocuous machine" re-ranks ID cards. Turned it on, card in slot: "Current rank 6". I guessed 1 = higher (wrong: 1 = Ensign, lower classes) while a welder closed in; fled NW and back, then typed 10 = GRAND FLEET HYPERADMIRAL. Card back in my uniform. No points yet; should open the ID-reader security doors (Sick Bay east, End of Corridor north on Level Six). Saved at Shady Dan's (before the rank change) — a fresh save follows.

**Cmds 364-400.** Shady Dan's down = Junk Yard (the Studio/Junk Yard double-title is a deliberate mirrored joke): MAGNETIC BOOTS — the game warned they'd wipe my ID card if carried together, so I left them. Alley hub: Loan Shark (strong box with a HUGE lock), Missionary (nothing), Warehouse (TRADING POST VACUUM STORAGE: closed airlock door down, "Trespassers will be spaced" — FREZONE is probably there; needs the space suit), "Doc" Schuster's (ostrich; letter: "ostrich nip... in my ceiling panel"; Floyd: "Wow! An elephant!"), Pawn Shop (took E-Z SPRAY SPORZ spray can = balloon-creature food). Plato now sneers: "Tagging along after this simpleton human is becoming tiresome." Uh-oh. Main Street UP = MAYOR'S OFFICE: "Deciphering Alien Speech" with a taste glossary tucked inside. DECODED the alien dots: "Hunji brethren: sabotage failed. However, I have shed light on the Zeenak weapon's solitary weakness: element 78 [platinum]! Turn back the deadly radiations! The air is souring..." So the platinum reflective foil is the anti-pyramid shield. File Room (headlamp): only boring files. Last command: HyperAdmiral card in the Sick Bay ID reader — "The security door slides open." Leg spent at 400.

## Leg handoff

**State at end of leg:** Sick Bay (Level Five), security door EAST just opened, not yet entered. Score 25/80, Day 2 (Novem 5), time ~5318. Hungry in ~57, sleepy in ~102. Floyd and Plato with me. **Latest save:** South Junction at cmd 396 (score 25, same inventory; the door was opened after it — from that save: NE, NW, E, put card in reader). Earlier saves overwritten; the in-game SAVE slot is a single one.

**Inventory:** piece of paper (alien glossary), spray can (E-Z Spray Sporz), J-series hyperdiode, reflective foil (platinum!), headlamp (worn, OFF), cup of Ramosian Fire Nectar, drill (small bit; ONE hole left), medium drill bit, twenty-ohm bedistor, survival kit > Thermos (open) > blue soup, uniform > ID card (rank 10 Grand Fleet HyperAdmiral), chronometer. Hands are full — drop something before picking up.

### Map so far
- **Duffy (start):** Deck Twelve (slot door port, unused), Forms Storage aft, Cargo Bay Entrance -> Robot Pool (Rex, Helen) / Cargo Bay.
- **Station Command Module** (ladder + elevator on the east side of each lobby):
  - L1 Dome: garden, locked warm STORAGE BIN (fuel cells; key in Commander's safe), air shaft grating.
  - L2 Mess Hall (FDU sprays acid; steaming coffee), N/S Main Storage (DETONATOR, blackened hyperdiode inside, opened), NE Meeting Room 1 -> S Meeting Room 2 -> S Library (nanofilm reader; lilac spool = truck fuel cells + "quarnum wrench"; puce = chapel flame/star diode; lilac spool on floor, puce in reader).
  - L3: N Gym (exercise machine, freq 710 sign), S Theatre (projection booth, ordinary lock), NW Laundry (presser, dryer, washer MISSING; stamp dropped here), SW Chapel (pulpit switch = eternal flame; blinking seven-pointed star).
  - L4: N Female Barracks (bed), S Male Barracks, SanFac between, W Docking Bay #3.
  - L5 (lobby): W Docking Bay #2 (our spacetruck), N Workshop -> N Storage (DARK; now have headlamp); NE North Junction: E Sick Bay (security door E now OPEN), N North Connection (E PX Vendo-Matic: timer #6, large drill bit #9, 1 galakmid each; W Storage; N Tube -> Scientific Sub-Module: Scientists' Quarters / Astro Lab+Office / Engineering Lab+Office (Schmidt diary) / Bio Lab+Office (bloody note) / Holding Tank (blasted, empty)); SE East Junction -> E East Connection (iris hatch + slot to village Makeshift Connector; S Comm Center: "abort, return to Duffy"; SW Station Control board); South Junction: SW File Room (dark, boring), SE Commander's Office (log reader destroyed) -> E Commander's Quarters (SAFE, 8000-dial), S Briefing Room -> W South Connection (hatch OPEN to village), W Robot Shop (sleeping Oliver, heating chamber).
  - L6: N Auxiliary Barracks+SanFac, NW Docking Bay #1 (ALIEN SHIP: pedestal, skeleton, dots), SW Docking Bay #4 (empty), S Officers' Quarters A/B/C + SanFac, SE End of Corridor (ID-reader security door N — try the HyperAdmiral card; E Shipping Room DARK).
  - L7 Printing Plant (trash can), NW Paper Recycling (twenty-prong fromitz board dropped there). Ladder to L8 SEALED from below (throbbing, vibrations).
- **Village (zero-gee), via South Connection:** Grimy Passage -> Main Street (UP Mayor's Office; S Bank; W Travel Agency; NE Greasy Straw -> NE Trading Post; SE/Down Alley). Trading Post: N Grocery (mauve spool) -> N Broadway (N Recruitment, E Field Office, NE Rec Shop booths, SE Barbershop (Assignment Completion Form left here), SW Pet Store (balloon creature + leash in cage), W Makeshift Connector (to East Connection hatch), Down/NW unexplored; platinum detector dropped here); E Saloon -> E Casino (roulette: N Opium Den, Up Flophouse with SPACE SUIT in locker); W Studio; SE Shady Dan's (ID-rank machine) -> Down Junk Yard (magnetic boots) -> W Alley (N Missionary, S Loan Shark strong box, NE Warehouse vacuum airlock down, SE Doc Schuster's (ostrich, letter), SW Pawn Shop); Trading Post Down unexplored.

### Puzzles solved
Robot form -> Floyd (bin 3); spacetruck (both seats, hatch closed, course from form table: 4750-4799 = 445); ate goo when hungry; stamp under Commander's bed; Floyd fetches hot drill bit; crumpled village form -> stamp -> Laundry presser (close, on, wait, off, open) -> South Connection slot (+6); barbershop mirror -> platinum foil (+4); roulette wheel exits (+4); hyperdiode from sculpture; ID card to rank 10 at Shady Dan's; alien dots tasted + Mayor's glossary decoded; Sick Bay security door opened.

### Open puzzles and theories
1. **Commander's safe** -> key -> Dome bin -> fuel cells. Theory: drill ONE hole (which bit? try medium or the PX large; "hole of appropriate diameter"), fill with FREZONE explosive (probably in the Warehouse vacuum storage — wear the Flophouse SPACE SUIT; keep it below 150 K: carry it in the insulated Thermos? empty the soup first), put the J-series hyperdiode in the Main Storage DETONATOR, attach detonator to explosive and a TIMER (PX item 6 — needs a galakmid coin; Loan Shark strong box? casino? dice?), set timer, leave.
2. **Pyramid** is loose below Level Eight (sealed ladder). The foil (platinum) reflects its radiation. Plato is turning nasty — likely under its control.
3. **Galakmid coin** for the PX: unknown source.
4. Security doors: Sick Bay E (open now — go in!), End of Corridor N on L6.
5. Balloon creature + spore spray: maybe a smelly/propulsive helper (welders? zero-g?). Magnetic boots (keep away from ID card). Ostrich / "ceiling panel" letter. Exercise machine freq 710. Theatre booth lock. Chapel star diode. Twelve/twenty-prong fromitz boards + bedistor (repairs?). Military Sub-Module hatch (East Connection). Hull welders stalk you — keep moving.

### What I would try next
Walk through the Sick Bay security door. Then the L6 End of Corridor door with the card. Get the space suit, enter the Warehouse airlock for FREZONE (bring the Thermos). Find a galakmid (check the Loan Shark box, Trading Post down, Broadway down/NW, Travel Agency posters). Assemble the safe-cracking kit in the Commander's Quarters. Watch food: the only food left is the blue soup in the Thermos (and maybe the nectar).

## Leg 2

**Start:** Sick Bay, score 25, time 5318, security door E open.

**Cmds 1-20.** Brig behind the Sick Bay door: three empty cells, nothing. Headlamp on, Workshop -> Storage: a JAMMER (black box, antenna, TWENTY tiny sockets — the twenty-prong fromitz board I left on L7!; frequency 0-1400, set 337). Dropped the nectar there, took jammer. Hull welder #2 had been in the Workshop; dodged. L6 End of Corridor: HyperAdmiral card opens the security door -> ARMORY (+5, 30): fusor-beam ZAPGUN, indicator "7" (charges?). Saved in the Armory. The Inventory button's "(hands full)" never goes away.

**Cmds 21-45.** Leaving the Armory, PLATO stunned me with a stun ray and monologued: the pyramid is a Zeenak weapon that turns machines against their makers and builds replicas. Floyd, "in quandry", finally leapt at the gun; Plato landed on it, the power pack blew, Plato gone (+7, 37). Floyd crying oil. Took everything back. Shipping Room: forklift missing sign, joke form boxes. L7: took the twenty-prong board (the "more than seven things may fumble" rule explained "(hands full)"; stashed paper+hyperdiode in the survival kit) and put it in the jammer. Saved at End of Corridor after Plato.

friction.why: The keypad option number changed from 526 (robot bin) to 585 (autopilot) though both are 'keypad'; I reused the old number and got 'not on screen'. Minor, but a same-name thing with a different number trips you

friction.command: Tell Floyd to... Take the medium drill bit
friction.result: Floyd grabs it from the heating chamber, 'Yikes, it's hot!', drops it; +3
friction.why: The Tell Floyd menu offered exactly the thing I needed after the chamber refused my hand; felt like Planetfall's Floyd-fetches puzzles, and his Oliver speech just before was lovely

friction.result: Long taste-by-taste transcription of the alien message
friction.why: The diary's hint ('nonvisual properties') plus a Taste entry right in the dots' menu made the discovery feel earned; the Floyd/Plato Lazarus exchange here hit my Planetfall nostalgia hard

friction.result: Motor strains; '(This drill has one hole left in it. Drill the safe again to spend it there.)' - nothing drilled
friction.why: Good: it warned me before I wasted the one-use drill. Not sure which of three bits to use though, and nothing says the hole's purpose

friction.result: Mirror turns to glass dust; reflective foil behind it; taking the foil +4
friction.why: The platinum detector's beeping pointed me to the room, but nothing said the mirror was special ('standard, old-fashioned glass mirror'); breaking it was a guess I'd only make after saving. Satisfying but a bit arbitrary

friction.result: Printed a bare 'Junk Yard' line and a junk-pile paragraph, then '## Studio' with its own description
friction.why: Two room names for one move; I wasn't sure whether I was in the Junk Yard or the Studio (the header/compass say Studio). Probably the intended 'oops it is art' joke, but the unformatted first title reads like a rendering glitch

friction.result: Warned that the magnetic soles would wipe my just-upgraded ID card; take again to go ahead
friction.why: Saved me from ruining the HyperAdmiral card I had just made; a clear, fair warning. (Also: the Studio/Junk Yard double-title turns out to be a deliberate joke in both directions, so my earlier 'confusing' row is minor.)

friction.result: You can't search a ceiling!
friction.why: The click menu offered Search on the ceiling, and a letter had just told me something is hidden in 'my ceiling panel', so the offer read as a hint; the game then flatly refuses it. Menus shouldn't offer verbs the game rejects for that object

friction.result: A taste-to-word glossary; decoding the alien dots gives: sabotage failed, the weapon's one weakness is element 78, turn back the deadly radiations
friction.why: Best moment of the leg: I had copied the tastes from the alien ship, and the glossary made the translation mine to do. Pure Infocom. (Holding many items: 'hands full' makes each pickup a juggling act, though)

friction.result: Taken, but the Inventory button still says '(hands full)'
friction.why: The 'hands full' label stays on after I drop things and keeps letting me take more, so I no longer trust it and dropped the nectar needlessly

friction.result: Floyd knocks the stun ray away, Plato is blown apart, Floyd cries tears of oil (+7)
friction.why: A genuinely moving Floyd moment; the Tell Floyd menu offering 'Save you' / 'Turn off Plato' while paralysed made the scene feel interactive

friction.command: sleep (Flophouse bed, explosive in closed Thermos in the survival kit)
friction.result: Woke with all items dropped and the note '(The game can no longer be won: the explosive was gone when you woke, and there was only the one.)'
friction.why: No in-story explanation of where the explosive went (warmed? taken?), though the out-of-game warning saved me from wandering for hours in a dead game

friction.result: 'klunk' but nothing in the hole; kick/push/break all 'fail to dislodge the timer'; Floyd reaching in finds nothing; restoring and retrying jams identically
friction.why: I spent my only coin and the one item I need is stuck, with no hint what would shake it loose

friction.result: a panel mounted in the ceiling
friction.why: letter clue (ceiling panel) paid off; the new object appeared in the menu marked (new)

friction.result: You'll have to open the counter first.
friction.why: the counter menu (and More...) offers no Open, so a click player cannot follow the game's own advice; earlier the same Search found the nectar

friction.result: You can see nothing in the plastic bag.
friction.why: Day 3, hungry, every food source I know is used up or deadly (FDU acid, poisoned coffee); searched counter, garbage, bag with no luck; I fear the run is starving out

friction.result: BLAM! The dispenser is dispensed.
friction.why: good joke, but the jammed timer vanished with it and there was no warning; I used the session's one-move UNDO (not a save restore)

friction.result: The radio crackles to life. Breaker. Over.
friction.why: someone is calling, but the click menus offer no way to speak or answer into the radio

friction.result: it farts right in your face... you drop everything you were holding
friction.why: great payoff of the pet-store sign (farting propulsion); laughed out loud

friction.result: You collapse from extreme thirst and hunger. You have died. Score 45 of 80.
friction.why: the run starved out on Day 3; I never found a food source after the survival kit, the fire nectar and the taffy were gone

friction.result: hungry, worse in ~1 move - shown unchanged over about five turns (open cage, take leash twice, take can), then death
friction.why: the countdown on the Diagnose button stopped moving, so I could not tell how many moves I really had left

friction.command: put coin in slot; type 6; dispenser/hole menus
friction.result: Klunk, nothing appears, even on the morning of Day 2 (so the jam is not lateness). Hole menu offers Examine, Look inside, Push, Turn, Kick, Break, Climb, Look under/behind, Touch, Smell, Scare, Put something in; no Reach in / Search / Feel inside.
friction.why: Second run hitting the same wall. As a click player I cannot tell whether the answer is a verb the menu does not offer (reach into the hole) or an object I have not found. Would like a hint or a Reach in entry on holes.

friction.result: Died: Floyd burst into tears and fled, Plato fired. Death #2 of the session (score 41, Day 2). In run 1 the same ambush ended with Floyd leaping at the gun (+7).
friction.why: The game says 'you can't move a muscle, but you can still speak', but click mode offers only Wait/Look/Inventory etc., no Say or Talk to Floyd. I cannot tell whether speaking to Floyd is the intended way to tip his loyalty, or whether something earlier decided it. As a click player the death feels unavoidable.

friction.result: The booth has no door.
friction.why: The booth's click menu offers Close for a thing that cannot be closed, which cost a turn. Small, but the menu promised an action.

friction.command: Floyd > Tell Floyd to > Save you / Turn off Plato / Help! / Take the stun ray (while stunned)
friction.result: Each plea: 'Floyd in quandry...'; on Plato's final turn Floyd leapt at the gun, Plato was blown apart (+7, score 48). Earlier this run, Waiting silently four times got me killed.
friction.why: Wonderful scene, and the Floyd menu grows context entries (Save you, Turn off Plato) exactly when needed. But the only cue was 'you can still speak'; the Floyd menu did not look like it applied while paralysed, so my first attempt died. Worth making the speak cue point at Floyd.

friction.result: The neck of the Thermos is too narrow for the cup of coffee. The coffee menu (incl. More) has no Pour/Empty entry.
friction.why: The obvious move is to pour the coffee into the empty Thermos; I can only put the whole cup in. If pouring is possible in the original, click mode hides it.

friction.result: Tell Floyd to... offers only Say hello / Follow you / Help! here; Help! gives 'Enough talking! Let's play Hider-and-Seeker.'
friction.why: Standing by a securely affixed air-shaft grating and a locked bin with Floyd beside me, I want 'Floyd, open the grating' or 'Floyd, go into the air shaft' (Planetfall habit). Click mode gives no way to direct Floyd at a specific object, so I can't tell whether he's the solution.

friction.result: The drunk ostrich's menu offers 'Get in' and 'Sit in' as top-level verbs, alongside Examine/Give.
friction.why: In click mode the menu is my only hint system, so odd entries read as clues. I spent thought on whether I'm meant to ride or sit in an ostrich. If they're generic container verbs, they mislead here.

friction.result: Every Take All (after the beacon shock and the balloon fart) also tries to take Floyd; now he shoves me: 'will you just leave Floyd alone!'
friction.why: The Take all button is the natural recovery after a drop-everything event, but it always includes Floyd, so I get scolded each time. Cute once; after three times it feels like the button's scope is wrong (people/robots shouldn't be in 'all').

friction.result: farts, drop everything; then: (It will do this every time here. Perhaps it would behave differently somewhere with gravity.)
friction.why: Clear, in-voice nudge after the repeat; turns a slapstick loop into a direction

friction.result: You shove the pair of magnetic boots up into the hole. A moment later, it drops out and lands on the floor.
friction.why: First real texture on the jammed timer: the hole goes UP, so something that rises (the balloon creature, which floats in gravity?) might reach it. Magnet theory disproved cleanly.

friction.result: Stops after 2-3 Time passes each time Floyd does a flavour line (bump/curse, joke)
friction.why: The convenience button needed three presses plus a Sleep that said not tired yet; Floyd ambient lines interrupt it

friction.command: spray can (in the room next to the creature)
friction.result: The Arcturian balloon creature farts in, hungrily gobbling up the spores.
friction.why: Big aha: you herd it room to room with the spores. Earlier I sprayed in its own room then walked off, which teaches nothing; the adjacent-room spray is the trick. Lovely, but nothing pointed at it except the sign.

friction.result: creature farts in from next room, gobbling spores
friction.why: spores lure the creature between rooms - lovely aha after many failed leash attempts

friction.result: creature hyperinflates, lifts me 2 m off the deck; Footnote 4 on parallel dimensions
friction.why: payoff for the gravity hint; funny footnote

friction.result: Nothing happens. (shake: seems to be empty)
friction.why: spore can is a finite resource with no low-warning; I wasted sprays on earlier experiments and the PX detour and ran dry one room short of the Chapel

friction.result: Taken. +7, score 55
friction.why: multi-step balloon puzzle (spores lure, gravity lift) pays off with a clear green points notice
